title: 相思
author: Wang Wei

translation: Red beans grow in the southern land
In spring they put out a few new sprigs
Gather them as many as you can, my friend
For they are the very symbol of longing

annotations.红豆: red beans — called 'love seeds' (相思子), a classical token of longing
annotations.南国: the southern land, south of the Yangtze
annotations.君: you — a respectful address to a friend

appreciation: Wang Wei takes the tiniest thing — a red bean — and loads it with the weight of longing. The poem was written to a friend, not a lover, which is why it has become the all-purpose Chinese poem for missing anyone dear. 'Gather more of them,' he says, 'because each one is longing itself made visible.'
